looks.label: Deep Field
looks.about: The night sky: near-black ground and a few real stars. The planet edge is on the standee only.

looks.label: Paper
looks.about: Light paper, navy type, one blue word, ink hairlines. Same layout as Deep Field, cheaper to print, easy to read up close.

assets.name: Standee
assets.print: Tarpaulin standee, 2 × 5 ft (24 × 60 in), matte, portrait, with eyelets in the 4 corners for an X-stand. Send the PDF. Test the QR on 2 phones from 1 m and 2 m before printing. Stand it at the back of the walkway, facing the aisle.

versions.note: The night sky: the logo, “Welcome to Atenean Networking”, a dipper-shaped constellation of what people are open to, and the planet’s edge with a blue glow. On the night side: the QR beside “Scan to join.”, then both plans.
Paper: the same layout on light paper, navy type, “Networking” in BlueLink blue.
Big type: “Find your people.”, an unlabelled constellation, the planet’s edge, and the QR and both plans on the night side.

assets.name: Header
assets.print: Tarpaulin, 3.5 × 1.25 ft (42 × 15 in), matte, with grommets in the 4 corners. Optional. Zip-tie the top grommets to the front bar of the tent, across our half only. Measure the eave first: with a 2.0 m eave the bottom edge is at 1.62 m.

versions.note: The night sky: the logo big, “Find your people.”, and the planet’s edge along the bottom.
Paper: the same layout on light paper, navy type, “people.” in BlueLink blue.
Big type: the logo big and “Welcome to Atenean Networking” (the V3 standee says “Find your people.”).

assets.name: QR sign
assets.print: Glossy or matte A4, in an A4 acrylic stand. One sign per stand. Test the QR on 2 phones before printing.

versions.note: Centred, near-black: “Scan to join.”, a 128 mm QR, and both plans split by a hairline.
Price list, on paper: “Scan to join.”, a 136 mm QR, and both plans in a ruled two-column table.
Big type, near-black: “Find your people.”, a 118 mm QR, and both plans set large, left and right.

assets.name: Info carousel
assets.print: One carousel post, 5 slides in this order. The main explainer: pin it to the top of the profile. Copy the caption below.
assets.caption:
BlueLink is a private network for the Ateneo community. Find internships, and connect with orgs, businesses, alumni, and mentors.

It’s exclusive to Ateneans, so it’s a safe space for people who want to network and find opportunities.

Membership is ₱99 a year or ₱250 for lifetime access, with a full refund within 7 days. Sign up through the link in our bio, or visit us at the LAS Bazaar, Red Brick Road, Tent 34B.

Made by Ateneans. Not an official Ateneo de Manila University service.

versions.note: One idea per slide, each with its own layout: the headline, one statement with its key phrases lit, members only with a closed ring of stars, both plans at the same size (a year and lifetime access), and the steps as a constellation. One line of stars runs along the bottom of all 5.
